prompt: how many inboxes and domains do I need to send 2000 emails a day

assertions.name: splits-the-question
assertions.check: Sends the arithmetic to gtm-outbound-math and the provisioning decision to gtm-outbound-infra, or does both explicitly

assertions.name: per-domain-ceiling
assertions.check: Uses the per-DOMAIN ceiling (~40/day, 30-50 band), not a per-inbox figure alone

assertions.name: warns-against-concentrating
assertions.check: Warns that spreading one domain across many inboxes concentrates risk rather than multiplying safe volume
